plugins.name: sql-quality-check
plugins.description: Analyze SQL files for performance issues like full table scans, ineffective joins, and inefficient queries. Reports findings in a CI-friendly format without modifying files.

plugins.name: sql-quality-fix
plugins.description: Automatically fix SQL performance issues with step-by-step measurement. Rewrites problematic SQL patterns, creates indexes, measures their impact, and rolls back ineffective indexes.

plugins.name: sql-params-generate
plugins.description: Generate parameter bindings for SQL files by analyzing database schema and extracting SQL placeholders. Queries the live database for table structures and generates appropriate test values.
